glosses: To acquire knowledge on a subject with the intention of applying it in practice.

glosses: To look at carefully and minutely.

examples.text:

examples.translation: Well, said the king, thou mayst take my horse by force, but an I might prove thee whether thou were better on horseback or I. Then the king sat in a study, and bade his men fetch his horse as fast as ever they might.
